question: Which of the following devices is used in application such as Computer Aided Design (CAD)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Plotters**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The device used in applications such as **Computer Aided Design (CAD)** is the **plotter**.
 
• Plotters are specialized printers that create high-quality, precise drawings and graphics on large sheets of paper,
 
 
• making them ideal for architectural plans, engineering designs, and other CAD applications.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Scanners**:

 
 
• A scanner is a device used to convert physical documents, images, or objects into digital form.
 
• It is commonly used for digitizing photographs, printed documents, and artwork.
 
• While useful in many fields, scanners are not typically used for CAD applications, which involve creating designs rather than digitizing them.
 
 
 
• **Speakers**:
 
 
• Speakers are devices that convert electrical signals into sound.
 
• They are primarily used for audio output in multimedia applications, including playing music, sounds, or alerts.
 
• Speakers are not relevant to CAD applications, which focus on visual design rather than audio output.
 
 
 
• **Pantographs**:
 
 
• A pantograph is a mechanical device used to copy and scale drawings or images.
 
• It consists of linkages that allow a user to trace an image while simultaneously creating a larger or smaller copy.
